prompts.aura: Game VFX sprite, sparse authentic low-resolution pixel art for Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup tiles. One isolated circular broken crimson katana aura with two small magenta sparks, transparent background. No character, no weapon object, no lettering. Square composition, generous transparent hollow centre occupying 65 percent width so a 32px game actor remains fully visible. Fine red and rose-pink crescent blade wisps restricted to left and right outer border. Hard pixels, limited palette, no blur, no shadows, no background. Intended to downsample to a single 32x32 game tile; extremely readable and minimal.
prompts.slash: Game VFX sprite: one isolated broad curved katana slash sweeping from lower left to upper right, luminous ivory cutting edge, crimson red trailing edge, a few red sparks. Genuine low-resolution pixel art, hard chunky pixels, limited palette, no blur or glow haze. Transparent background, no actor, no sword object, no text. Square composition, centre mostly transparent except thin curved blade edge, intended 64x64 sprite over a dungeon monster. Clear slicing crescent, NOT a straight laser beam. Single slash only.
prompts.duel: Game VFX sprite: one isolated square crimson oni duel seal, authentic low-resolution pixel art, transparent background. Four sharp red horn-shaped corner motifs joined by very thin broken dark-red and pink ritual lines along the outside border. Hollow transparent centre occupies 80 percent of area to leave dungeon actors fully readable. No filled circle, no solid floor, no character, no Japanese letters, no text, no background. A tiny stylized two-horn oni face emblem on bottom border only. Limited crimson/rose/ivory palette, hard pixels, no blurry glow. Intended single 96x96 tile overlay covering3x3 dungeon cells.
